findings: Real vulnerability: OAuth callback links by email, keeps basic-auth password, and auto-verifies a previously unverified local row, enabling pre-registration password takeover after the victim's normal OAuth login.

BIC is 4e48320cf19e12a7195643dcbcf0360acb0821d8 adding the existing-account EmailVerifiedAt nil-to-now block; parent 34a91f3195c98069b35ddcdfd59a142d6865c63e still left that row unverified and login.go blocked password login.
BIC object is human-authored Lakhan Samani with no AI/bot/generator marker; independent AI-role gate agrees with primary_verdict NOT_AI.
